asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
mov     [rbp+c], rdi
mov     [rbp+x], esi
mov     [rbp+y], edx
mov     eax, [rbp+y]
sar     eax, 5
add     eax, 20h ; ' '
mov     cl, al
mov     rax, [rbp+c]
mov     [rax], cl
mov     eax, [rbp+y]
and     eax, 1Fh
add     eax, 60h ; '`'
mov     cl, al
mov     rax, [rbp+c]
mov     [rax+1], cl
mov     eax, [rbp+x]
sar     eax, 5
add     eax, 20h ; ' '
mov     cl, al
mov     rax, [rbp+c]
mov     [rax+2], cl
mov     eax, [rbp+x]
and     eax, 1Fh
add     eax, 40h ; '@'
mov     cl, al
mov     rax, [rbp+c]
mov     [rax+3], cl
mov     rax, [rbp+c]
mov     byte ptr [rax+4], 0
pop     rbp
retn
